AboutHanin.title: About HANIN
AboutHanin.paragraph1: HANIN specializes in plating on ABS plastic and metal substrates, and also paints and prints on plastic and metal products.
AboutHanin.paragraph2: HANIN was founded in {{founded}} and belongs to the Hanin Tech system (founded in {{hqFounded}}). The factory covers {{area}} m² at Lot {{lot}}, Quang Minh Industrial Park, Hanoi, with {{staff}} employees and more than {{customers}} customers.

0.title: ABS and ABS/PC Plating
0.desc: Nickel chrome 3+, nickel chrome 6+, satin nickel, black nickel chrome; a hairline finish can be applied on nickel chrome.

1.title: Nickel, Chrome and Satin Plating on Metal
1.desc: Electrolytic nickel, electroless nickel, black nickel, nickel chrome and satin plating for iron, copper, steel and aluminum parts.

2.title: Zinc, Copper, Tin Plating and Black Phosphating
2.desc: Zinc, copper, tin plating and black manganese phosphating for rust resistance and better adhesion.

3.title: PVD, Spray Painting and Printing
3.desc: PVD vacuum coating on 2 machines; spray painting, printing and laser on plastic and metal products.
